conversion_rule: SNK Neo Geo buttons + motions -> Tekken-style inputs. A (LP)=1, C (HP)=2, B (LK)=3, D (HK)=4. f/b/d/u directions map directly. qcf/qcb/hcf/qcb+hcf/qcf,qcf/qcf+hcb motions preserved. Charge motions noted, Tekken input keeps the end direction+button. Close-only throws = 1+3-family. Colliding inputs get a ~variant suffix on the key only; entry.input keeps the true input.
limb_convention: 1=armR(LP), 2=armL(HP), 3=legL(LK), 4=legR(HK); input keys prefixed ~ are dictionary variants sharing an input

b/d/f+2.name: Yume-Zakura
b/d/f+2.notes: air b/d/f+C close; air-catch knee drop slam

d,u+1.name: Musasabi no Mai Back
d,u+1.notes: charge d,u or charge d then u/b+A/C, EX OK; dive

d,u/f+1.name: Musasabi no Mai Front
d,u/f+1.notes: charge d, u/f+A/C, EX OK; wall-kick dive

hcf+3.name: Hissatsu Shinobi-Bachi
hcf+3.notes: hcf+B/D, EX OK; cartwheel elbow strike

qcb+1.name: Ryuuenbu
qcb+1.notes: qcb+A/C, EX OK; flaming belt spin

qcb+1~air.name: Musasabi no Mai Air
qcb+1~air.notes: air qcb+A/C, EX OK; straight dive-down

qcf,hcb+1+2.name: Shiranui-Ryuu Ougi Kunoichi
qcf,hcb+1+2.notes: Climax, air OK; wall-dive barrage into spinning leg slam

u/f+3.name: Sankaku-Tobi
u/f+3.notes: air u/f near wall; wall jump
